/***************************************
 * 
 * VCU Homepage - CSS for various components and layout modifcations
 * Author: mahuff
 *
 * Table of contents:
 * 
 * Set root variables
 * Spacing rules
 * Global img width
 * Transitions
 * Typography & Button styles
 * Multi-column UL
 * Full-width option
 * Embeded video - responsive
 * Hero - sub page header (Marcom - Hero)
 * Billboard component (plugin-card)
 * Image List component (plugin-card)
 * Callout box (plugin-card)
 * Stats card (plugin-card)
 * Stats list (plugin-card)
 * Hover card (plugin-card)
 * Card themes - classes for black, gold bg
 * Image stacked card (plugin-card)
 * Image/ info card (plugin-card)
 * Carousel revisions [Marcom - Owl Carousel (Multi)]
 * Story carousel - Add bg for caption [Marcom - Owl Carousel (Multi)]
 * Take note - Announcement bar (plugin-notification)
 *
 ****************************************/
/* Set variables */
:root {
    --hp-color--orange: #b02e01;
    --hp-color--gold: #ffb300;
    --hp-color--black: #000000;
    --hp-color--white: #ffffff;
    --hp-color--offblack: #121212;
    --hp-color--offwhite: #f5f5f5;
    --hp-transition--ease-in-out: .2s ease-in-out;
    /* here until we refactor -- SG 8/16/24 */
    --cwf-color--gold: #ffb300;
    /*--cwf-color--black:#000;
    --cwf-color--gold:#ffb300;
    --cwf-color--blue:#006894;
    --cwf-color--purple:#80225f;
    --cwf-color--green:#007e00;
    --cwf-color--orange:#d43900;
    --cwf-color--red:#b50000;
    --cwf-accent--background:var(--cwf-color--blue);
    --cwf-accent--foreground:var(--cwf-color--white);
    --cwf-font--sans-serif:Roboto,sans-serif;
    --cwf-font--serif:Merriweather,serif;
    --cwf-font:var(--cwf-font--sans-serif);
    --cwf-contain--margin:0 auto;
    --cwf-contain--width:100%;
    --cwf-contain--max-width:1400px;
    font-family:var(--cwf-font,var(--cwf-font--sans-serif,inherit));
    font-size:1.125em*/;
}
.cwf-footer__link--social {
    /* here until we refactor -- SG 8/16/24 */
    --cwf-footer__link--social--active--background-color: #ffb300;
}
/* Global img width */
/* Add to base.css -- Needed for FFox */
img {
    width: 100%;
}
/****************************************/
/* Spacing */
/* Bottom of <main> Add padding space */
main#cwf-content {
    padding-bottom: 3rem !important;
}
/****************************************/
/* Transitions */
.hp-transition--ease-in-out {
    -webkit-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    -moz-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    -o-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
}
/****************************************/
/* Typography styles */
/* Color - Text headers in #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(h2,h3):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-card--img-stacked :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-fact :where(h2,h3)) {
    color: var(--hp-color--orange);
}
/* Set paragraph font weight */
#cwf-content p {
    font-weight: 300;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Why VCU - text link styles */
/* Why VCU default - .section */
:is(.thrive-slide, .financialGuidance) a,
/* main site default - #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(a,a:active,a:link):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-cta :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-fact :where(a,a:active,a:link)) {
        /*color: var(--hp-color--orange);*/
        cursor: pointer;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid;
        border-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
        padding-bottom: 2px;
        color: var(--hp-color--black);
        font-weight: 700;
}
/* Why VCU default - .section */
:is(.thrive-slide, .financialGuidance) :is(a:hover,a:focus),
/* main site default - #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(a:hover,a:focus):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-cta :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-fact :where(a:hover,a:focus)) {
        text-decoration: none;
        color: var(--hp-color--orange);
        border-color: transparent;
}
/* Why VCU - black bg text links */
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
}
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:active,
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:hover,
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:focus {
   color: var(--hp-color--white) !important;
   border-color: transparent !important;
}
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
    :is(#Test-Market) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
}
    :is(#Test-Market) a:active,
    :is(#Test-Market) a:hover,
    :is(#Test-Market) a:focus {
       color: var(--hp-color--white) !important;
       border-color: transparent !important;
    }
}
/* Why VCU - gold bg text links */
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--black) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--black) !important;
}
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:active,
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:hover,
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:focus {
   color: var(--hp-color--orange) !important;
   border-color: transparent !important;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Text color classes */
.hp-text--white {color:var(--hp-color--white) !important;}
.hp-text--gold {color:var(--hp-color--gold) !important;}
.hp-text--black {color:var(--hp-color--black) !important;}
/*********************************************/
/* Text case */
.hp-text--uppercase {text-transform: uppercase !important;}
/*********************************************/
/* Videos embeded in general content type */
/* Example is on the Athletics page */
.video-embed--wrapper {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 56.25%;
 /* 16:9 */
    height: 0;
}
.video-embed--wrapper  iframe {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Button styles */
.cwf-button,
.t4_button {
    --hp-button--background-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--border-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--color: #121212;
    --hp-button--active--background-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--active--color: #fff;
    --hp-button--hover-focus--background-color: #212121;
    --hp-button--hover-focus--color: #fff;
}
.cwf-button,
a.t4_button,
.t4_button a, 
.t4_button button,
.t4_button input[type=button], 
.t4_button input[type=reset], 
.t4_button input[type=submit] {
    border-radius: 1.5rem;
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: var(--cwf-font--sans-serif,inherit);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.5;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem !important;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color .1s ease-in-out,color .1s ease-in-out;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -moz-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
}
#cwf-content :is(a.t4_button,.t4_button a):not(.hp-billboard a.t4_button) {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--background-color)!important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--color)!important;
}
#cwf-content :is(a.t4_button:hover,a.t4_button:active,a.t4_button:focus):not(.hp-billboard a.t4_button) {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--background-color)!important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--color)!important;
}
/* Add icon */
p.t4_button:after,
a.t4_button:after,
.t4_button button:after {
    font-family: FontAwesome;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    content: "\f105";
    display: inline-block;
    margin: -2px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    padding-left: 8px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}
/* Black Button Variant (9.5.25 mh) */
.cwf-button--black,
.t4_button--black {
    --hp-button--background-color: #000;
    --hp-button--border-color: #000;
    --hp-button--color: #fff;
    --hp-button--active--background-color: #000;
    --hp-button--active--color: #fff;
    /* hover/focus/active inherit from defaults */
}
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--background-color) !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--color) !important;
}
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:hover,
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:active,
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:focus,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:hover,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:active,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:focus {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--background-color) !important;
    border: 1px solid #000;
    color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--color) !important;
}
/****************************************/
/* Multi-column UL */
/* Create a two column unordered list */
@media (min-width:800px) {
    ul.list--2-columns {
        -webkit-column-count: 2;  /* Chrome/Opera, Safari */
        -moz-column-count: 2; /* Mozilla Firefox */
        column-count: 2;
        /* Properties below are optional: */
        -webkit-column-gap: 50px; /* Chrome/Opera, Safari */
        -moz-column-gap: 50px; /* Mozilla Firefox */
        column-gap: 50px;
    }
}
/****************************************/
/* Full-width option for content blocks */
/* Create full-width blocks using the .hp-full-width class */
.hp-full-width {
    width: 100vw;
    position: relative;
    left: 50%;
    right: 50%;
    /* add half of main's left pad to the midpoint */
    margin-left: calc(-50vw - 0.5rem);
    /* push content back on screen */
    padding-left: 1rem;
 }
/* Full-width blocks -- If there is a sub nav, modify margin */
@media (min-width:1024px) {
  :is(.cwf-grid__column--page-layout--subnav+main.cwf-grid__column--page-layout--main .hp-full-width) {
        /* margin-left: calc(-50vw - 160px - 1rem); */
        margin-left: calc(-50vw - 151.5px + 1rem);
   }
}
/****************************************/
/* Hero image header on sub-pages */
/* Using the Marcom - Multimedia Hero */
/* Use 'hero-feature-subpage' in T4 name field */
/* Reset any inherited defaults */
#hp-feature-subpage .owl-item.active .marcom-hero .content,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero,
#hero-feature-subpage .marcom-hero-overlay,
#hero-feature-subpage .content .textTitle,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle p,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle h1,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle h2, 
#hero-feature-subpage .content .inner,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {all:unset;all:revert;}
/* Hero - subpage title + image */
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
  --hero-feature-subpage--background-color: #fab300;
  --hero-feature-subpage--foreground-color: #121212;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero img {
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--hero-feature-subpage--background-color);
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
  background: var(--hero-feature-subpage--background-color);
  padding: 1rem 3rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  z-index: 2;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle h1,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle h2,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle p {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
/* Grid - hero-subpage-feature */
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: auto;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 2;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: -0.7rem;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero picture {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
@media (min-width:800px) {
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
      display: grid; 
      grid-template-columns: 0.1fr auto 1.2fr 0.1fr; 
      grid-template-rows: 1fr 1.6fr 0.4fr; 
      gap: 0px 0px; 
    }
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero picture { 
        grid-area: 1 / 1 / 4 / 5; 
    }
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
        grid-area: 3 / 2 / 4 / 3;
        margin: 0;
        margin-block-end: 0.6rem;
    }
}
/****************************************/
/* Testimonial v01 */
/* Using the Plugin-Card */
/* Use .hp-billboard to style a full-width testimonial (incl blockquote) */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard {
    --cwf-card--background-color: #121212;
    --cwf-card--foreground-color: #f5f5f5;
    background-color: var(--cwf-card--background-color);
    border: 0;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    z-index: 0;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__container {
    max-width: 100%;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__image {
    object-fit:cover; 
    width:100%;
    height:100% !important;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__body {
    padding: 5rem 3rem 3rem;
}
@media (min-width:1024px) {
    .hp-billboard .plugin-card__media {
        width:50%;
     }
     .hp-billboard .plugin-card__body {
        padding: 4rem;
        margin-left: 2rem;
    }
}
.hp-billboard blockquote {
    position:relative;
}
.hp-billboard blockquote p:first-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
    border-top: 0;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-style: normal;
    line-height:1.3;
    margin: 0 0 1rem;
}
.hp-billboard blockquote + p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-style: italic;
    padding-top: 2rem;
}
.hp-billboard strong {
    color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    font-style: normal;
}
/* Add fancy svg quotes */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after,
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    content: "";
    font-size: 4em;
    line-height: .3em;
    opacity: .5;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px !important;
    vertical-align: -.2em;
    padding: 0 0 0 .4em;
}
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 5;
    left: 0;
    top: -2rem;
    background-position: 0 0 !important;
}
@media (min-width:1024px) {
    .plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
        left: -2.8rem;
        top: -0.2rem;
    }
}
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after {
    background-position: 0 70px !important;
    margin-left: 0.35rem;
    line-height: 0;
}
/* Open quote T4 #621725 */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    /*background: transparent url('https://www.vcu.edu/media/vcu/assets/images/smart-quotes/smart-quotes-white-open.svg') no-repeat;
    background: transparent url("") no-repeat;*/
    background: url('/media/vcu-homepage/assets/images/smart-quotes-white-open.svg') transparent no-repeat;
}
/* Close quote T4 #621726 */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after {
    /*background: transparent url('https://www.vcu.edu/media/vcu/assets/images/smart-quotes/smart-quotes-white-close.svg') no-repeat;
    background: transparent url("") no-repeat;*/
    background: url('/media/vcu-homepage/assets/images/smart-quotes-white-close.svg') transparent no-repeat;
}
/* Hide blurred background image */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard .plugin-card__background {
    opacity:0 !important;
    display:none !important;
}
/****************************************/
/* Image List component */
/* Using the Plugin-Card */
/* Adjust default CSS for image list cards */
.plugin-card.hp-image-list {
    border: none; /* remove */
}
.hp-image-list .plugin-card__media {
    border: 5px solid var(--hp-color--gold);
}
.plugin-card.hp-image-list .plugin-card__background {
    webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
   backface-visibility: hidden;
   display: none !important; /* hide bg image */
}
@media (min-width:1024px) {
    /* Modify image placement and backgrounds */
    .hp-image-list .plugin-card__media {
        align-items: flex-start; /* top aligned */
        background-color: transparent; /* hide black bg */
        width: 35%; /* adjust; override the default 25% width */
    }
    .hp-image-list .plugin-card__image {
        position: relative;
        object-fit: cover; /* Fill the space */
        width: 100%;
        height: 100% !important; /* override style */
    }
}
/****************************************/
/* Callout box v01 */
/* Using the Plugin-Card */

/****************************************/
/* Hover Card style v01 */
/* Title and photo visible */
/* On hover:  Blurb and title animate in view */
/* Add .cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal to parent div */ 
/* plugin- cards are child elements */
.cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal {
  grid-gap:.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container {
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    -webkit-transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    -o-transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3 {
    position: absolute;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    bottom: 0;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgb(2,0,36);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%, rgba(20,20,20,.75) 35%, rgba(34,34,34,.75) 100%);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body a {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    background: #000;
    width: 100%;
    color: #fff;
    text-transform: none;
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__background {
    display:none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover img,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus img {
    opacity: .3;
}
/* Transform on hover & focus */
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h2, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h3, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h3 {
    background: 0 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:focus p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus p {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
/* Card link */
.hp-card-reveal a,
.hp-card-reveal a:link {
color: #ffb300 !important;
font-weight: 700 !important;
line-height: 1 !important;
text-transform: uppercase !important;
border: 0 !important;
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 10px 0 0 !important;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:hover,
.hp-card-reveal a:focus {
color: #e57200;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:after {
position: relative;
font-family: FontAwesome;
font-weight: 400;
font-size: 16px;
color: #e57200;
content: "\f105";
display: inline-block;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
  padding-left: 0px;
line-height: 1;
padding-left: 8px;
top: -1px;
vertical-align: middle;
}
.hp-card-reveal a::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  content: ' ';
}

/*
	ClickCards
	Make the entire plugin-card clickable, linking to the first link contained 
	within the card. If no link exists, the click event is not applied. 
*/
class ClickCards {
	static defaults = {
		selector: '.plugin-card'
	};
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = { ...this.constructor.defaults, ...options };
		this.init();
	}//constructor
	init() {
		const _this = this;
		let cards = document.querySelectorAll(_this.options.selector);
		if (cards) {
			cards.forEach((card, index) => {
				const id = `pCard${index}`;
				const link = card.querySelector('a');
				if (link) {
					card.addEventListener('click', function() {
						location = link.href;
					});
					card.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
						if (evt.key == 'Enter') {
							location = evt.target.dataset.href;
						}
					});
					card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
					card.tabIndex = 0;
					card.setAttribute('role', 'link');
					card.dataset.href = link.href;
					//card.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `#${id}`);
					link.tabIndex = -1;
					link.id = id;
				}
			});
		}
	}
	static initCards(options) {
		return new ClickCards(options);
	}
}//class

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    function loadClickCards(selector) {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
            ClickCards.initCards({ selector: selector });
        }
    }
    loadClickCards('.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-click .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card');
});

  getShortNavWithChildren() {
    const shortNavItems = this.json.filter((item1) =>

    );

  getShortNavItems() {
    const shortNavList = this.navShortMenu?.querySelector("ul");

    if (shortNavList.children.length > 1) {
      Array.from(shortNavList.children).forEach((item, index) => {
        const title = item.querySelector("a")?.textContent.trim();
        const url = item.querySelector("a")?.href.trim();
        // full menu hamburger is in the t4 link menu, skip it
        if (index) {
          shortNavResult.push({ title: title, url: url });
        }
      });
    }
    return shortNavResult;

  setActiveShortMenuItem(elem) {

  isDescendent(elem, parent) {
    while (elem) {

    }
    return false;
  } //isDescendent

// Set the toggle's "aria-expanded" attribute
function toggleExpanded(toggle) {
  // If there's no toggle, do nothing else...
  if (!toggle) return;
  // ... otherwise, set its "aria-expanded" attribute to the opposite value
  let newState = 0;
  if (toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") {
    newState = false;
  } else {
    newState = true;
  }
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
  toggle.parentElement.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
}

/***************************************
 * 
 * VCU Homepage - CSS for various components and layout modifcations
 * Author: mahuff
 *
 * Table of contents:
 * 
 * Set root variables

 * Global img width
 * Transitions
 * Typography & Button styles
 * Multi-column UL

 * Billboard component (plugin-card)
 * Image List component (plugin-card)
 * Callout box (plugin-card)
 * Stats card (plugin-card)
 * Stats list (plugin-card)
 * Hover card (plugin-card)
 * Card themes - classes for black, gold bg
 * Image stacked card (plugin-card)
 * Image/ info card (plugin-card)
 * Carousel revisions [Marcom - Owl Carousel (Multi)]
 * Story carousel - Add bg for caption [Marcom - Owl Carousel (Multi)]
 * Take note - Announcement bar (plugin-notification)
 *
 ****************************************/
/* Set variables */
:root {
    --hp-color--orange: #b02e01;
    --hp-color--gold: #ffb300;

    --hp-color--offwhite: #f5f5f5;
    --hp-transition--ease-in-out: .2s ease-in-out;
    /* here until we refactor -- SG 8/16/24 */
    --cwf-color--gold: #ffb300;
    /*--cwf-color--black:#000;
    --cwf-color--gold:#ffb300;
    --cwf-color--blue:#006894;
    --cwf-color--purple:#80225f;
    --cwf-color--green:#007e00;
    --cwf-color--orange:#d43900;
    --cwf-color--red:#b50000;
    --cwf-accent--background:var(--cwf-color--blue);
    --cwf-accent--foreground:var(--cwf-color--white);
    --cwf-font--sans-serif:Roboto,sans-serif;
    --cwf-font--serif:Merriweather,serif;
    --cwf-font:var(--cwf-font--sans-serif);
    --cwf-contain--margin:0 auto;
    --cwf-contain--width:100%;
    --cwf-contain--max-width:1400px;
    font-family:var(--cwf-font,var(--cwf-font--sans-serif,inherit));
    font-size:1.125em*/;
}
.cwf-footer__link--social {
    /* here until we refactor -- SG 8/16/24 */
    --cwf-footer__link--social--active--background-color: #ffb300;
}
/* Global img width */
/* Add to base.css -- Needed for FFox */
img {
    width: 100%;
}
/****************************************/
/* Spacing */
/* Bottom of <main> Add padding space */
main#cwf-content {
    padding-bottom: 3rem !important;
}
/****************************************/
/* Transitions */
.hp-transition--ease-in-out {
    -webkit-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    -moz-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    -o-transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
    transition: var(--hp-transition--ease-in);
}
/****************************************/
/* Typography styles */
/* Color - Text headers in #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(h2,h3):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-card--img-stacked :where(h2,h3), 
    .hp-fact :where(h2,h3)) {
    color: var(--hp-color--orange);
}
/* Set paragraph font weight */
#cwf-content p {
    font-weight: 300;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Why VCU - text link styles */
/* Why VCU default - .section */
:is(.thrive-slide, .financialGuidance) a,
/* main site default - #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(a,a:active,a:link):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-cta :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(a,a:active,a:link), 
    .hp-fact :where(a,a:active,a:link)) {
        /*color: var(--hp-color--orange);*/
        cursor: pointer;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid;
        border-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
        padding-bottom: 2px;
        color: var(--hp-color--black);
        font-weight: 700;
}
/* Why VCU default - .section */
:is(.thrive-slide, .financialGuidance) :is(a:hover,a:focus),
/* main site default - #cwf-content */
#cwf-content :is(a:hover,a:focus):not(
    .hp-billboard :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-stats-list :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-card-reveal :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-cta :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-sxsvideo :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-verticalvideos :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-people-profiles-title :where(a:hover,a:focus), 
    .hp-fact :where(a:hover,a:focus)) {
        text-decoration: none;
        color: var(--hp-color--orange);
        border-color: transparent;
}
/* Why VCU - black bg text links */
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
}
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:active,
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:hover,
:is(.wgyb, #A-unique-combination, #Set-you-apart) a:focus {
   color: var(--hp-color--white) !important;
   border-color: transparent !important;
}
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
    :is(#Test-Market) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--gold) !important;
}
    :is(#Test-Market) a:active,
    :is(#Test-Market) a:hover,
    :is(#Test-Market) a:focus {
       color: var(--hp-color--white) !important;
       border-color: transparent !important;
    }
}
/* Why VCU - gold bg text links */
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a {
    border-color: var(--hp-color--black) !important;
    color: var(--hp-color--black) !important;
}
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:active,
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:hover,
:is(#Champion-of-diversity) a:focus {
   color: var(--hp-color--orange) !important;
   border-color: transparent !important;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Text color classes */
.hp-text--white {color:var(--hp-color--white) !important;}
.hp-text--gold {color:var(--hp-color--gold) !important;}
.hp-text--black {color:var(--hp-color--black) !important;}
/*********************************************/
/* Text case */
.hp-text--uppercase {text-transform: uppercase !important;}
/*********************************************/
/* Videos embeded in general content type */
/* Example is on the Athletics page */
.video-embed--wrapper {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 56.25%;
 /* 16:9 */
    height: 0;
}
.video-embed--wrapper  iframe {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}
/*********************************************/
/* Button styles */
.cwf-button,
.t4_button {
    --hp-button--background-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--border-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--color: #121212;
    --hp-button--active--background-color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    --hp-button--active--color: #fff;
    --hp-button--hover-focus--background-color: #212121;
    --hp-button--hover-focus--color: #fff;
}
.cwf-button,
a.t4_button,
.t4_button a, 
.t4_button button,
.t4_button input[type=button], 
.t4_button input[type=reset], 
.t4_button input[type=submit] {
    border-radius: 1.5rem;
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: var(--cwf-font--sans-serif,inherit);
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.5;
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem !important;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color .1s ease-in-out,color .1s ease-in-out;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -moz-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
}
#cwf-content :is(a.t4_button,.t4_button a):not(.hp-billboard a.t4_button) {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--background-color)!important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--color)!important;
}
#cwf-content :is(a.t4_button:hover,a.t4_button:active,a.t4_button:focus):not(.hp-billboard a.t4_button) {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--background-color)!important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--color)!important;
}
/* Add icon */
p.t4_button:after,
a.t4_button:after,
.t4_button button:after {
    font-family: FontAwesome;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1;
    content: "\f105";
    display: inline-block;
    margin: -2px 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    padding-left: 8px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}
/* Black Button Variant (9.5.25 mh) */
.cwf-button--black,
.t4_button--black {
    --hp-button--background-color: #000;
    --hp-button--border-color: #000;
    --hp-button--color: #fff;
    --hp-button--active--background-color: #000;
    --hp-button--active--color: #fff;
    /* hover/focus/active inherit from defaults */
}
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--background-color) !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--hp-button--border-color);
    color: var(--hp-button--color) !important;
}
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:hover,
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:active,
#cwf-content .cwf-button.cwf-button--black:focus,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:hover,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:active,
#cwf-content .t4_button.t4_button--black:focus {
    background-color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--background-color) !important;
    border: 1px solid #000;
    color: var(--hp-button--hover-focus--color) !important;
}
/****************************************/
/* Multi-column UL */
/* Create a two column unordered list */
@media (min-width:800px) {
    ul.list--2-columns {
        -webkit-column-count: 2;  /* Chrome/Opera, Safari */
        -moz-column-count: 2; /* Mozilla Firefox */
        column-count: 2;
        /* Properties below are optional: */
        -webkit-column-gap: 50px; /* Chrome/Opera, Safari */
        -moz-column-gap: 50px; /* Mozilla Firefox */
        column-gap: 50px;
    }
}
/****************************************/
/* Full-width option for content blocks */
/* Create full-width blocks using the .hp-full-width class */
.hp-full-width {
    width: 100vw;
    position: relative;
    left: 50%;
    right: 50%;
    /* add half of main's left pad to the midpoint */
    margin-left: calc(-50vw - 0.5rem);
    /* push content back on screen */
    padding-left: 1rem;
 }
/* Full-width blocks -- If there is a sub nav, modify margin */
@media (min-width:1024px) {
  :is(.cwf-grid__column--page-layout--subnav+main.cwf-grid__column--page-layout--main .hp-full-width) {
        /* margin-left: calc(-50vw - 160px - 1rem); */
        margin-left: calc(-50vw - 151.5px + 1rem);
   }
}
/****************************************/
/* Hero image header on sub-pages */
/* Using the Marcom - Multimedia Hero */
/* Use 'hero-feature-subpage' in T4 name field */
/* Reset any inherited defaults */
#hp-feature-subpage .owl-item.active .marcom-hero .content,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero,
#hero-feature-subpage .marcom-hero-overlay,
#hero-feature-subpage .content .textTitle,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle p,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle h1,
#hero-feature-subpage .textTitle h2, 
#hero-feature-subpage .content .inner,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {all:unset;all:revert;}
/* Hero - subpage title + image */
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
  --hero-feature-subpage--background-color: #fab300;
  --hero-feature-subpage--foreground-color: #121212;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero img {
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--hero-feature-subpage--background-color);
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
  background: var(--hero-feature-subpage--background-color);
  padding: 1rem 3rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  z-index: 2;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle h1,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle h2,
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .textTitle p {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
/* Grid - hero-subpage-feature */
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: auto;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 2;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: -0.7rem;
}
#hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero picture {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
@media (min-width:800px) {
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero {
      display: grid; 
      grid-template-columns: 0.1fr auto 1.2fr 0.1fr; 
      grid-template-rows: 1fr 1.6fr 0.4fr; 
      gap: 0px 0px; 
    }
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero picture { 
        grid-area: 1 / 1 / 4 / 5; 
    }
    #hero-feature-subpage.marcom-hero .content {
        grid-area: 3 / 2 / 4 / 3;
        margin: 0;
        margin-block-end: 0.6rem;
    }
}
/****************************************/
/* Testimonial v01 */
/* Using the Plugin-Card */
/* Use .hp-billboard to style a full-width testimonial (incl blockquote) */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard {
    --cwf-card--background-color: #121212;
    --cwf-card--foreground-color: #f5f5f5;
    background-color: var(--cwf-card--background-color);
    border: 0;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    z-index: 0;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__container {
    max-width: 100%;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__image {
    object-fit:cover; 
    width:100%;
    height:100% !important;
}
.hp-billboard .plugin-card__body {
    padding: 5rem 3rem 3rem;
}
@media (min-width:1024px) {
    .hp-billboard .plugin-card__media {
        width:50%;
     }
     .hp-billboard .plugin-card__body {
        padding: 4rem;
        margin-left: 2rem;
    }
}
.hp-billboard blockquote {
    position:relative;
}
.hp-billboard blockquote p:first-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
    border-top: 0;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-style: normal;
    line-height:1.3;
    margin: 0 0 1rem;
}
.hp-billboard blockquote + p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-style: italic;
    padding-top: 2rem;
}
.hp-billboard strong {
    color: var(--hp-color--gold);
    font-style: normal;
}
/* Add fancy svg quotes */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after,
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    content: "";
    font-size: 4em;
    line-height: .3em;
    opacity: .5;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px !important;
    vertical-align: -.2em;
    padding: 0 0 0 .4em;
}
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 5;
    left: 0;
    top: -2rem;
    background-position: 0 0 !important;
}
@media (min-width:1024px) {
    .plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
        left: -2.8rem;
        top: -0.2rem;
    }
}
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after {
    background-position: 0 70px !important;
    margin-left: 0.35rem;
    line-height: 0;
}
/* Open quote T4 #621725 */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:before {
    /*background: transparent url('https://www.vcu.edu/media/vcu/assets/images/smart-quotes/smart-quotes-white-open.svg') no-repeat;
    background: transparent url("") no-repeat;*/
    background: url('/media/vcu-homepage/assets/images/smart-quotes-white-open.svg') transparent no-repeat;
}
/* Close quote T4 #621726 */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard p:only-child:after {
    /*background: transparent url('https://www.vcu.edu/media/vcu/assets/images/smart-quotes/smart-quotes-white-close.svg') no-repeat;
    background: transparent url("") no-repeat;*/
    background: url('/media/vcu-homepage/assets/images/smart-quotes-white-close.svg') transparent no-repeat;
}
/* Hide blurred background image */
.plugin-card.hp-billboard .plugin-card__background {
    opacity:0 !important;
    display:none !important;
}

/****************************************/
/* Hover Card style v01 */
/* Title and photo visible */
/* On hover:  Blurb and title animate in view */
/* Add .cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal to parent div */ 
/* plugin- cards are child elements */
.cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal {
  grid-gap:.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container {
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    -webkit-transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    -o-transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3 {
    position: absolute;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    bottom: 0;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgb(2,0,36);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%, rgba(20,20,20,.75) 35%, rgba(34,34,34,.75) 100%);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body a {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    background: #000;
    width: 100%;
    color: #fff;
    text-transform: none;
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__background {
    display:none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover img,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus img {
    opacity: .3;
}
/* Transform on hover & focus */
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h2, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h3, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h3 {
    background: 0 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:focus p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus p {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
/* Card link */
.hp-card-reveal a,
.hp-card-reveal a:link {
color: #ffb300 !important;
font-weight: 700 !important;
line-height: 1 !important;
text-transform: uppercase !important;
border: 0 !important;
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 10px 0 0 !important;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:hover,
.hp-card-reveal a:focus {
color: #e57200;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:after {
position: relative;
font-family: FontAwesome;
font-weight: 400;
font-size: 16px;
color: #e57200;
content: "\f105";
display: inline-block;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
  padding-left: 0px;
line-height: 1;
padding-left: 8px;
top: -1px;
vertical-align: middle;
}
.hp-card-reveal a::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  content: ' ';
}

/*
	ClickCards
	Make the entire plugin-card clickable, linking to the first link contained 
	within the card. If no link exists, the click event is not applied. 
*/
class ClickCards {
	static defaults = {
		selector: '.plugin-card'
	};
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = { ...this.constructor.defaults, ...options };
		this.init();
	}//constructor
	init() {
		const _this = this;
		let cards = document.querySelectorAll(_this.options.selector);
		if (cards) {
			cards.forEach((card, index) => {
				const id = `pCard${index}`;
				const link = card.querySelector('a');
				if (link) {
					card.addEventListener('click', function() {
						location = link.href;
					});
					card.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
						if (evt.key == 'Enter') {
							location = evt.target.dataset.href;
						}
					});
					card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
					card.tabIndex = 0;
					card.setAttribute('role', 'link');
					card.dataset.href = link.href;
					//card.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `#${id}`);
					link.tabIndex = -1;
					link.id = id;
				}
			});
		}
	}
	static initCards(options) {
		return new ClickCards(options);
	}
}//class

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    function loadClickCards(selector) {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
            ClickCards.initCards({ selector: selector });
        }
    }
    loadClickCards('.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-click .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card');
});

/****************************************/
/* Hover Card style v01 */
/* Title and photo visible */
/* On hover:  Blurb and title animate in view */
/* Add .cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal to parent div */ 
/* plugin- cards are child elements */
.cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal {
  grid-gap:.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container {
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    -webkit-transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    -o-transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3 {
    position: absolute;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    bottom: 0;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgb(2,0,36);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%, rgba(20,20,20,.75) 35%, rgba(34,34,34,.75) 100%);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body a {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    background: #000;
    width: 100%;
    color: #fff;
    text-transform: none;
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__background {
    display:none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover img,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus img {
    opacity: .3;
}
/* Transform on hover & focus */
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h2, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h3, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h3 {
    background: 0 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:focus p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus p {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
/* Card link */
.hp-card-reveal a,
.hp-card-reveal a:link {
color: #ffb300 !important;
font-weight: 700 !important;
line-height: 1 !important;
text-transform: uppercase !important;
border: 0 !important;
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 10px 0 0 !important;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:hover,
.hp-card-reveal a:focus {
color: #e57200;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:after {
position: relative;
font-family: FontAwesome;
font-weight: 400;
font-size: 16px;
color: #e57200;
content: "\f105";
display: inline-block;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
  padding-left: 0px;
line-height: 1;
padding-left: 8px;
top: -1px;
vertical-align: middle;
}
.hp-card-reveal a::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  content: ' ';
}

<script>
/*
 *   File:   carousel-tablist.js
 *   Source:  https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/carousel/examples/carousel-2-tablist/ 
 *   Desc:   Carousel Tablist widget that implements ARIA Authoring Practices
 *
 */

'use strict';

// takes options object: { accessibleCaptions: boolean, autoplay: boolean, playButton: boolean }
// defaults are: { accessibleCaptions: true, autoplay: false, playButton: true }

var CarouselTablist = function (node, options) {
  // merge passed options with defaults
  options = Object.assign(
    { moreaccessible: false, paused: true, norotate: false },
    options || {}
  );

  // a prefers-reduced-motion user setting must always override autoplay
  var hasReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  if (hasReducedMotion.matches) {
    options.paused = true;
  }

  /* DOM properties */
  this.domNode = node;

  this.tablistNode = node.querySelector('[role=tablist]');
  this.containerNode = node.querySelector('.carousel-items');

  this.tabNodes = [];
  this.tabpanelNodes = [];

  this.liveRegionNode = node.querySelector('.carousel-items');
  this.pausePlayButtonNode = document.querySelector(
    '.carousel-tablist .controls button.rotation'
  );

  this.playLabel = 'Start automatic slide show';
  this.pauseLabel = 'Stop automatic slide show';

  /* State properties */
  this.hasUserActivatedPlay = false; // set when the user activates the play/pause button
  this.isAutoRotationDisabled = options.norotate; // This property for disabling auto rotation
  this.isPlayingEnabled = !options.paused; // This property is also set in updatePlaying method
  this.timeInterval = 5000; // length of slide rotation in ms
  this.currentIndex = 0; // index of current slide
  this.slideTimeout = null; // save reference to setTimeout

  // initialize tabs
  this.tablistNode.addEventListener('focusin', this.handleTabFocus.bind(this));
  this.tablistNode.addEventListener('focusout', this.handleTabBlur.bind(this));

  var nodes = node.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');

  for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    var n = nodes[i];

    this.tabNodes.push(n);

    n.addEventListener('keydown', this.handleTabKeydown.bind(this));
    n.addEventListener('click', this.handleTabClick.bind(this));

    // initialize tabpanels

    var tabpanelNode = document.getElementById(n.getAttribute('aria-controls'));

    if (tabpanelNode) {
      this.tabpanelNodes.push(tabpanelNode);

      // support stopping rotation when any element receives focus in the tabpanel
      tabpanelNode.addEventListener(
        'focusin',
        this.handleTabpanelFocusIn.bind(this)
      );
      tabpanelNode.addEventListener(
        'focusout',
        this.handleTabpanelFocusOut.bind(this)
      );

      var imageLink = tabpanelNode.querySelector('.carousel-image a');

      if (imageLink) {
        imageLink.addEventListener(
          'focus',
          this.handleImageLinkFocus.bind(this)
        );
        imageLink.addEventListener('blur', this.handleImageLinkBlur.bind(this));
      }
    } else {
      this.tabpanelNodes.push(null);
    }
  }

  // Pause Button
  if (this.pausePlayButtonNode) {
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.addEventListener(
      'click',
      this.handlePausePlayButtonClick.bind(this)
    );
  }

  // Handle hover events
  this.domNode.addEventListener('mouseover', this.handleMouseOver.bind(this));
  this.domNode.addEventListener('mouseout', this.handleMouseOut.bind(this));

  // initialize behavior based on options

  this.enableOrDisableAutoRotation(options.norotate);
  this.updatePlaying(!options.paused && !options.norotate);
  this.setAccessibleStyling(options.moreaccessible);
  this.rotateSlides();
};

/* Public function to disable/enable rotation and if false, hide pause/play button*/
CarouselTablist.prototype.enableOrDisableAutoRotation = function (disable) {
  this.isAutoRotationDisabled = disable;
  this.pausePlayButtonNode.hidden = disable;
};

/* Public function to update controls/caption styling */
CarouselTablist.prototype.setAccessibleStyling = function (accessible) {
  if (accessible) {
    this.domNode.classList.add('carousel-tablist-moreaccessible');
  } else {
    this.domNode.classList.remove('carousel-tablist-moreaccessible');
  }
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.hideTabpanel = function (index) {
  var tabNode = this.tabNodes[index];
  var panelNode = this.tabpanelNodes[index];

  tabNode.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
  tabNode.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');

  if (panelNode) {
    panelNode.classList.remove('active');
  }
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.showTabpanel = function (index, moveFocus) {
  var tabNode = this.tabNodes[index];
  var panelNode = this.tabpanelNodes[index];

  tabNode.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  tabNode.removeAttribute('tabindex');

  if (panelNode) {
    panelNode.classList.add('active');
  }

  if (moveFocus) {
    tabNode.focus();
  }
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.setSelectedTab = function (index, moveFocus) {
  if (index === this.currentIndex) {
    return;
  }
  this.currentIndex = index;

  for (var i = 0; i < this.tabNodes.length; i++) {
    this.hideTabpanel(i);
  }

  this.showTabpanel(index, moveFocus);
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.setSelectedToPreviousTab = function (moveFocus) {
  var nextIndex = this.currentIndex - 1;

  if (nextIndex < 0) {
    nextIndex = this.tabNodes.length - 1;
  }

  this.setSelectedTab(nextIndex, moveFocus);
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.setSelectedToNextTab = function (moveFocus) {
  var nextIndex = this.currentIndex + 1;

  if (nextIndex >= this.tabNodes.length) {
    nextIndex = 0;
  }

  this.setSelectedTab(nextIndex, moveFocus);
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.rotateSlides = function () {
  if (!this.isAutoRotationDisabled) {
    if (
      (!this.hasFocus && !this.hasHover && this.isPlayingEnabled) ||
      this.hasUserActivatedPlay
    ) {
      this.setSelectedToNextTab(false);
    }
  }

  this.slideTimeout = setTimeout(
    this.rotateSlides.bind(this),
    this.timeInterval
  );
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.updatePlaying = function (play) {
  this.isPlayingEnabled = play;

  if (play) {
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.setAttribute('aria-label', this.pauseLabel);
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.classList.remove('play');
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.classList.add('pause');
    this.liveRegionNode.setAttribute('aria-live', 'off');
  } else {
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.setAttribute('aria-label', this.playLabel);
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.classList.remove('pause');
    this.pausePlayButtonNode.classList.add('play');
    this.liveRegionNode.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  }
};

/* Event Handlers */

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleImageLinkFocus = function () {
  this.liveRegionNode.classList.add('focus');
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleImageLinkBlur = function () {
  this.liveRegionNode.classList.remove('focus');
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleMouseOver = function (event) {
  if (!this.pausePlayButtonNode.contains(event.target)) {
    this.hasHover = true;
  }
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleMouseOut = function () {
  this.hasHover = false;
};

/* EVENT HANDLERS */

CarouselTablist.prototype.handlePausePlayButtonClick = function () {
  this.hasUserActivatedPlay = !this.isPlayingEnabled;
  this.updatePlaying(!this.isPlayingEnabled);
};

/* Event Handlers for Tabs*/

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabKeydown = function (event) {
  var flag = false;

  switch (event.key) {
    case 'ArrowRight':
      this.setSelectedToNextTab(true);
      flag = true;
      break;

    case 'ArrowLeft':
      this.setSelectedToPreviousTab(true);
      flag = true;
      break;

     case 'ArrowUp':
      this.setSelectedToPreviousTab(true);
      flag = true;
      break;

    case 'ArrowDown':
      this.setSelectedToNextTab(true);
      flag = true;
      break;

    case 'Home':
      this.setSelectedTab(0, true);
      flag = true;
      break;

    case 'End':
      this.setSelectedTab(this.tabNodes.length - 1, true);
      flag = true;
      break;

    default:
      break;
  }

  if (flag) {
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();
  }
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabClick = function (event) {
  var index = this.tabNodes.indexOf(event.currentTarget);
  this.setSelectedTab(index, true);
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabFocus = function () {
  this.tablistNode.classList.add('focus');
  this.liveRegionNode.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  this.hasFocus = true;
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabBlur = function () {
  this.tablistNode.classList.remove('focus');
  if (this.playState) {
    this.liveRegionNode.setAttribute('aria-live', 'off');
  }

  this.hasFocus = false;
};

/* Event Handlers for Tabpanels*/

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabpanelFocusIn = function () {
  this.hasFocus = true;
};

CarouselTablist.prototype.handleTabpanelFocusOut = function () {
  this.hasFocus = false;
};

/* Initialize Carousel Tablists and options */

window.addEventListener(
  'load',
  function () {
    var carouselEls = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-tablist');
    var carousels = [];

    // set example behavior based on
    // default setting of the checkboxes and the parameters in the URL
    // update checkboxes based on any corresponding URL parameters
    var checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll(
      '.carousel-options input[type=checkbox]'
    );
    var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var carouselOptions = {};

    // initialize example features based on
    // default setting of the checkboxes and the parameters in the URL
    // update checkboxes based on any corresponding URL parameters
    checkboxes.forEach(function (checkbox) {
      var checked = checkbox.checked;

      if (urlParams.has(checkbox.value)) {
        var urlParam = urlParams.get(checkbox.value);
        if (typeof urlParam === 'string') {
          checked = urlParam === 'true';
          checkbox.checked = checked;
        }
      }

      carouselOptions[checkbox.value] = checkbox.checked;
    });

    carouselEls.forEach(function (node) {
      carousels.push(new CarouselTablist(node, carouselOptions));
    });

    // add change event to checkboxes
    checkboxes.forEach(function (checkbox) {
      var updateEvent;
      switch (checkbox.value) {
        case 'moreaccessible':
          updateEvent = 'setAccessibleStyling';
          break;
        case 'norotate':
          updateEvent = 'enableOrDisableAutoRotation';
          break;
      }

      // update the carousel behavior and URL when a checkbox state changes
      checkbox.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
        urlParams.set(event.target.value, event.target.checked + '');
        window.history.replaceState(
          null,
          '',
          window.location.pathname + '?' + urlParams
        );

        if (updateEvent) {
          carousels.forEach(function (carousel) {
            carousel[updateEvent](event.target.checked);
          });
        }
      });
    });
  },
  false
);

/*
	ClickCards
	Make the entire plugin-card clickable, linking to the first link contained 
	within the card. If no link exists, the click event is not applied. 
*/
class ClickCards {
	static defaults = {
		selector: '.plugin-card'
	};
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = { ...this.constructor.defaults, ...options };
		this.init();
	}//constructor
	init() {
		const _this = this;
		let cards = document.querySelectorAll(_this.options.selector);
		if (cards) {
			cards.forEach((card, index) => {
				const id = `pCard${index}`;
				const link = card.querySelector('a');
				if (link) {
					card.addEventListener('click', function() {
						location = link.href;
					});
					card.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
						if (evt.key == 'Enter') {
							location = evt.target.dataset.href;
						}
					});
					card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
					card.tabIndex = 0;
					card.setAttribute('role', 'link');
					card.dataset.href = link.href;
					//card.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `#${id}`);
					link.tabIndex = -1;
					link.id = id;
				}
			});
		}
	}
	static initCards(options) {
		return new ClickCards(options);
	}
}//class 
//window.addEventListener('load', function() {
//    ClickCards.initCards({selector: '.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card'});
//});
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    function loadClickCards(selector) {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
            ClickCards.initCards({ selector: selector });
        }
    }
    loadClickCards('.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-click .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card');
});

function toggleExpanded(toggle) {
  // If there's no toggle, do nothing else...
  if (!toggle) return;
  // ... otherwise, set its "aria-expanded" attribute to the opposite value
  let newState = 0;
  if (toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") {
    newState = false;
  } else {
    newState = true;
  }
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
  toggle.parentElement.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
}

    // If there's no visibility set, return false...

    // ... otherwise, return whether the visibility includes "vcu" or not
    return visibility.includes('vcu');

function withinDateRange({ start, end }) {
    // If there's no date range set, return false
    if (!start && !end) return false;
    // Generate a JS date object from the alert's start/end datestamps...

        endDate = new Date(end),
        // ... as well as the current time

    return currentDate >= startDate && currentDate <= endDate;

/*
	ClickCards
	Make the entire plugin-card clickable, linking to the first link contained 
	within the card. If no link exists, the click event is not applied. 
*/
class ClickCards {
	static defaults = {
		selector: '.plugin-card'
	};
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = { ...this.constructor.defaults, ...options };
		this.init();
	}//constructor
	init() {
		const _this = this;
		let cards = document.querySelectorAll(_this.options.selector);
		if (cards) {
			cards.forEach((card, index) => {
				const id = `pCard${index}`;
				const link = card.querySelector('a');
				if (link) {
					card.addEventListener('click', function() {
						location = link.href;
					});
					card.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
						if (evt.key == 'Enter') {
							location = evt.target.dataset.href;
						}
					});
					card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
					card.tabIndex = 0;
					card.setAttribute('role', 'link');
					card.dataset.href = link.href;
					//card.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `#${id}`);
					link.tabIndex = -1;
					link.id = id;
				}
			});
		}
	}
	static initCards(options) {
		return new ClickCards(options);
	}
}//class 
//window.addEventListener('load', function() {
//    ClickCards.initCards({selector: '.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card'});
//});
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    function loadClickCards(selector) {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
            ClickCards.initCards({ selector: selector });
        }
    }
    loadClickCards('.hp-card--click-cards .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-click .plugin-card');
    loadClickCards('.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card');
});

  let newState = 0;

  }
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);

}

:is(.thrive-slide, .financialGuidance) a,

 }

/* Stats card v01 */
/* Using the Plugin-Card */
/* With before:{<div class="cwf-grid cwf-grid--[n]-columns hp-stats">} */
.hp-stats {
    justify-items:center;
    padding:1rem;
}
/* STATS bars */
.hp-stats .plugin-card {
  background: transparent;
  border:none;
  width: 100%;
}
@media (min-width:1020px) {
  .hp-stats .plugin-card {
    max-width: 350px;
    text-align: center;
  }
}
.hp-stats p,
.hp-stats a {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight:normal;
}
.hp-stats a:focus,
.hp-stats a:hover {
    text-decoration:none;
}
.hp-stats strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: 'thunderhouse-pro';
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    font-size: 9rem !important;
    padding: 0 0 1rem;;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 0.8 !important;
}
.hp-stats span {
    font-size: normal;
    vertical-align: middle !important;
}
/****************************************/
/*** Stats List v01 ***/
/* Example on 'Get Involved' page */
/* Stats in a flexbox grid : using list items in a UL */
/* Apply css:{.hp-stats-list} to the T4 content name */
/* Big number gets <strong> */
.hp-stats-list .plugin-card__container {
    padding: 1.5rem;
}
.hp-stats-list h3 {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    padding-bottom: 2rem;
    color: var(--hp-color--offblack)
}
.hp-stats-list ul {
    display: flex;
    list-style: none;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    gap: 6rem;
    justify-content: center;
    -webkit-align-items: center;
}
.hp-stats-list > * {
    flex: 1 1 0;
}
.hp-stats-list li {
    text-align: center;
}
.hp-stats-list li strong {
    font-family: Roboto,sans-serif;
    font-size: 4rem !important;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 0.8 !important;
    display: block;
}
.hp-stats-list li span {
    font-size: 1rem;
    vertical-align: middle !important;
}
.hp-stats-list--gold {
    background: var(--hp-color--gold);
}
/****************************************/
/* Hover Card style v01 */
/* Title and photo visible */
/* On hover:  Blurb and title animate in view */
/* Add .cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal to parent div */ 
/* plugin- cards are child elements */
.cwf-grid.hp-card-reveal {
  grid-gap:.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container {
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    -webkit-transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
    -o-transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s;
    transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s, -webkit-transform .35s;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body > h3 {
    position: absolute;
    vertical-align: baseline;
    bottom: 0;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: rgb(2,0,36);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%, rgba(20,20,20,.75) 35%, rgba(34,34,34,.75) 100%);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body a {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__body p {
    background: #000;
    width: 100%;
    color: #fff;
    text-transform: none;
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 50px, 0);
    font-size: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem !important;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__background {
    display:none;
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover img,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus img {
    opacity: .3;
}
/* Transform on hover & focus */
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h2, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h2,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus h3, 
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover h3 {
    background: 0 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, -200px, 0);
}
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:hover p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card__container:focus p,
.hp-card-reveal .plugin-card:focus p {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
/* Card link */
.hp-card-reveal a,
.hp-card-reveal a:link {
color: #ffb300 !important;
font-weight: 700 !important;
line-height: 1 !important;
text-transform: uppercase !important;
border: 0 !important;
padding: 0 !important;
margin: 10px 0 0 !important;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:hover,
.hp-card-reveal a:focus {
color: #e57200;
}
.hp-card-reveal a:after {
position: relative;
font-family: FontAwesome;
font-weight: 400;
font-size: 16px;
color: #e57200;
content: "\f105";
display: inline-block;
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
  padding-left: 0px;
line-height: 1;
padding-left: 8px;
top: -1px;
vertical-align: middle;
}
.hp-card-reveal a::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  content: ' ';
}

/*
	ClickCards
	Make the entire plugin-card clickable, linking to the first link contained 
	within the card. If no link exists, the click event is not applied. 
*/
class ClickCards {
	static defaults = {
		selector: '.plugin-card'
	};
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = { ...this.constructor.defaults, ...options };
		this.init();
	}//constructor
	init() {
		const _this = this;
		let cards = document.querySelectorAll(_this.options.selector);
		if (cards) {
			cards.forEach((card, index) => {
				const id = `pCard${index}`;
				const link = card.querySelector('a');
				if (link) {
					card.addEventListener('click', function() {
						location = link.href;
					});
					card.addEventListener('keydown', evt => {
						if (evt.key == 'Enter') {
							location = evt.target.dataset.href;
						}
					});
					card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
					card.tabIndex = 0;
					card.setAttribute('role', 'link');
					card.dataset.href = link.href;
					//card.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `#${id}`);
					link.tabIndex = -1;
					link.id = id;
				}
			});
		}
	}
	static initCards(options) {
		return new ClickCards(options);
	}
}//class

});

function toggleExpanded(toggle) {
  // If there's no toggle, do nothing else...
  if (!toggle) return;
  // ... otherwise, set its "aria-expanded" attribute to the opposite value
  let newState = 0;
  if (toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true") {
    newState = false;
  } else {
    newState = true;
  }
  toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
  toggle.parentElement.setAttribute("aria-expanded", newState);
}
